description:
Britney Spears's most loved tune gets the Brazilian carnival make-over from Brazil's ultimate brass band!
A Espetacular Charanga do Franca is one of Sao Paulo's most-loved carnival outfits - 50,000 people attended their carnival party earlier this year - and they finally release their most requested cover version

Said Thiago Franca: "Watching people jump around like crazy to this song at this year's carnival was something I will never forget"
Thiago is one of South America's finest saxophone players and the go-to brass arranger that everyone calls in Brazil - hence his mighty list of collaborators: Tony Allen, Criolo, Ceu, Marcelo D2, Planet Hemp, Joao Donato, Liniker, Don L
